scan_notes: Reviewed the complete scoped diff, emphasizing both authored page directories and the round-4 fixes. Verified the six forecast fill bands and both simulator reference lines against the captured payloads; checked control ordering, formatter parity, markdown/table escaping, as-of census records, and CARRIED parity scope. The as-of resolver and renderer apply the same per-trace predicate, and labels remain diagnostic only. The current simulator figures have sorted, duplicate-free, aligned x-spines, so the generic rowsFromFigure differences from pivot.py are not reachable from this builder today. Fact-check, text parity, page parity, lint, chrome-parity, and all non-temp-dependent Python tests passed. Frontend Vitest, one tmp_path test, and agent-browser could not run because the read-only sandbox forbids temporary/socket writes. I reproduced the partial-response defect directly against the built page DOM with jsdom.

findings.title: Partial responses retain sections omitted by the builder
findings.evidence: The fail-closed branch is entered only by `if (!nodeById(payload, 'sim-mechanics'))`; later repaint loops simply return when another node is absent, while `leaveEmpty` unhides every previous scenario box. The comment at lines 808-809 explicitly preserves the previous figure when a response omits it.
findings.failure_scenario: Start from the complete published page, then recompute against a database where `_collections(conn)` remains non-empty but `cohort_roas_dispersion` has no rows with `n >= 3`, or the locked ROAS curve is empty. `loan_simulator.build` still emits `sim-mechanics` but omits `sim-dispersion-group` and/or `sim-mix-group`. The guard therefore treats the response as complete. In the built DOM, both omitted groups remained `hidden=false` with their old text and chart/table, beside freshly recomputed KPIs and facility figures. The SPA replaces `payload.sections` and would remove them.
findings.suggested_fix: Reconcile visibility per scenario group: hide or clear every group absent from the response, including `sim-mix-group`, and restore only groups present in a later response. Add a built-DOM test covering partial omission followed by restoration.

findings.title: Forecast README labels an older artifact as the final build
findings.evidence: The README says `Measured on the final build (BUILD_BASE 26be1466)` and records `1,165,287 bytes`. The current artifact's `build_base.txt` contains `136d7a987241c6d2e36ddba505def3d64c47230b`, and `build/out.html` is 1,172,300 bytes after the later fixes.
findings.failure_scenario: A reviewer uses this README to identify which bytes received the reported gates and concludes that the current round-4-fixed artifact was measured. The documented base and byte count instead identify an older artifact, so the current rendered bytes lack the provenance the README claims.
findings.suggested_fix: After the final rebuild, update the build base and byte count—or label these results explicitly as a historical build and add the current results.

overall_explanation: The as-of changes, forecast bands, reference-line carry, DOM escaping, controls, and recorded page parity appear sound. The simulator still has a real stale-state path for builder-valid partial responses, and the forecast README's final-build provenance is stale. Neither rises to high severity on the currently captured client data.
